title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: PGA Tour Split Week
items.text: This week the PGA Tour features the star-studded Genesis Scottish Open at The Renaissance Club in Scotland with players like Scottie Scheffler and Rory McIlroy, while the ISCO Championship occurs at Hurstbourne CC in Kentucky, focusing on FedExCup points and job security.

items.headline: David Howard's Major Debut
items.text: David Howard qualified for the 154th Open at Royal Birkdale despite battling cystic fibrosis since age seven and overcoming severe health challenges, now aiming for low-amateur honors.

items.headline: Sergio Garcia Eyes DP World Tour Return
items.text: Sergio Garcia plans to regain his DP World Tour card and return in 2027 amid LIV Golf's funding uncertainties, expecting to play about four European events this season.
